identity: University of Amsterdam History (Geschiedenis), RIO 56034, registry row 414. 180 EC Dutch-taught full-time pathway; part-time enrolment is also listed for the target. No formal track selected.
sourceUse: The public study programme gives all current components and credits. The programme and transition subpages were also retrieved; their returned documents do not expose course-level conditions. No separate unverified admission threshold is asserted.
components: Independent historical inquiry based on secondary literature.
Digital collection, structuring and analysis of historical sources.
Verdiepingsvak II: concepten in de geschiedenis
Genuinely free elective space, including an optional minor or exchange.

progression.first-year: Period breadth, historiography, Amsterdam sources and the introductory 12 EC research seminar using secondary literature.
progression.second-year: Primary-source and historiographic work in Verdiepingsvak I, digital source analysis, public debates and historical theory. Preserve 12 EC of open choice.
progression.third-year: Concept-led advanced work, independent historical reading assessment and separate 12 EC bachelor thesis. Preserve 30 EC free choice, including a possible minor or exchange. Total open choice is 42 EC.
